title: ccaudit configuration
description: Defaults, per-provider log locations, and per-model price overrides for ccaudit. Every field is optional and every field has a command-line equivalent that overrides it. Searched at ./ccaudit.json then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ccaudit/config.json (else ~/.config/ccaudit/config.json), or named with --config.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete.

timezone.description: Default timezone for date grouping (--timezone): UTC, Local, or ±HH:MM.

no_cost.description: Omit every dollar figure from reports (--no-cost).

breakdown.description: Split each bucket into one row per model (--breakdown).

keys.description: Key rebinds for the TUI and the generated web bundle, keyed by action id. Values are key specs: a single character ("n", "?"), a named key ("tab", "enter", "esc", "up", "down", "left", "right", "pgup", "pgdn", "home", "end", "space", "backspace"), or a control chord ("ctrl-k"). Arrows, Enter, Esc and Ctrl+C keep their conventional meaning regardless.

sources.description: Per-provider settings, keyed by the --source id.

logs_dirs.description: Directories to read this provider's logs from, replacing its default location. Several roots are read as one corpus, so a live directory and an archive can be reported together.

prices.description: Per-model rate overrides in US dollars per million tokens. Keyed on the RAW model name as it appears in the logs (claude-opus-4-6-20251205), not the shortened display name — display names collapse date suffixes and would cover several distinctly priced models at once. Editing any rate invalidates the cached cost aggregation automatically.

additionalProperties.description: All four base rates are required: a partial override would blend user intent with a shipped default, and a missing rate reading as $0 is exactly the quiet wrong number this file exists to fix.

cache_write.description: Cache writes at the short (5-minute) TTL, $/M.

cache_write_1h.description: Cache writes at the 1-hour TTL, $/M. Defaults to cache_write for models with only one tier. Anthropic charges 2x input here against 1.25x for the 5-minute tier.
